title: The coax output style is reviewed and refined
body:
`styles/coax.md` is the output style of the Claude profile that coax runs, and Claude Code loads it into every coax session (coax-3d286f, coax-758c96). It lists the markdown forms coax draws and sets the shape of a reply. It gives the link forms for functions, lines, foam issues and colours, and says how to hand the person a command to run. The file is 143 lines. Several issues each added a rule to it, among them coax-5e39b9, coax-157c05 and coax-ec0448.

Jack asked for a review and refinement of the whole file. He has not yet set its scope.

## Open

- Which rules no longer match what coax draws, or how agents write in coax.
- Which rules repeat the global `CLAUDE.md` and could be cut from the style.
